leadsInvestigated.lead: (a) runPleadingQa checks relief vocabulary and template grade only, so it may pass fixtures containing invented court findings, fabricated fees, asserted prosecutor positions or populated protected fields
leadsInvestigated.detail: src/lib/record-clearing/pleading-qa.ts checks exactly: rendered flag, Grade E block, verified_replacement lifecycle block, caller-supplied prohibited relief terms, the required footer, [seal]/[logo] markers, and a soft warning if the relief term is absent. It is structurally blind to invented content and to populated protected fields. The qualification is that blindness in runPleadingQa is not by itself a shipped defect, because C2 and the C3 strict path layer real invention detectors on top of it. The defect is where no such layer exists: C1 (no invention scanner at all) and the C3 non-strict slugs ND/OH/OK. Both gaps were proven by mutation, not inferred — see C-S0-F1 and C-S0-F2. Protected-field enforcement, by contrast, is present in all three verifiers and caught its mutation everywhere it was tried.

leadsInvestigated.lead: (b) custom-pleading-renderer.ts falls back to the Pennsylvania presentation only when presentation is absent as a whole (:168), so a field-level null may reach the caption as the literal string 'null'
leadsInvestigated.verdict: CONFIRMED, and already shipped in committed artifacts; the true blast radius is wider than the lead states
leadsInvestigated.detail: resolvePresentation returns config.presentation ?? PA_DEFAULT_PRESENTATION, so a presentation object that is present but carries deliberately-null fields is used as-is and its nulls are interpolated into participant-facing text. Lane C's own C1 finding-2 discipline REQUIRES those nulls (a field the source is silent on is set to null beside a <field>NullReason note), so the discipline and the renderer are in direct conflict. Four shard-0 candidates ship the literal string 'null' in committed rendered output. The lead understates the radius in two ways: the leak is not confined to the caption (it reaches the party-identity paragraph, the eligibility-basis sentence, the verification clause and the proposed-order header), and it is not confined to presentation (eligibilityData.eligibilityBasisLabel is nullable on the same path). No 'undefined' or 'NaN' occurrences were found anywhere in shard-0 rendered output.

findings.defect: The pinned registry commit 3b6f4c103d2f97249b45acc0ea3fb889ff8787e5 is not present in a fresh clone of this repository. The consequence is asymmetric and dangerous: generate-rcap-track-terminalization.mjs --check dies with an unhandled execFileSync error and a raw Node stack, while C2 and C3 degrade SILENTLY, emitting 'pinned registry commit not available locally; authority cross-check skipped' as a warning and still reporting per-track 'ok'. The skipped check is the first mustVerify item for every controlled pleading in this shard — that the pleading cites the operative authority the registry records. A reviewer working a fresh clone would see green on a check that never ran.

Route structure is the strongest of the three composed routes reviewed and is genuinely terminal: all three legal units are enumerated against the pinned registry with unitIds preserved, all three resolve to real delivered components (a rendered pleading, an agency request letter, routing guidance), filing/participant separation is explicit and correct (exactly one court document, on the court-application branch only), omissionProof is substantive, and provenance resolves and fingerprints match. It cannot be approved as it stands because the primary-filing component's committed canonical render carries five literal 'null' occurrences and three unresolved caption tokens — the same renderer defect as the C1 pleadings. Correction is confined to the rendered output; the route design needs no change.

NONTERMINAL — cannot be approved. Unit 2 (ca-diversion-seal-stage-2) is the operative filing that actually obtains the relief, and it is an official_form_dependency with drafted:false whose own condition states 'Only in counties where LegalEase has collected and approved the current local petition and order set. No county qualifies yet.' Both named forms are status named_but_not_collected_or_approved, neither is in the CA state-pack inventory, and one has no form number, no URL and no sha256. Unit 3 (FW-001 fee waiver) is likewise undrafted and blocked on lane-D acquisition. The route is honest about all of this — the blocked components do not disappear, they carry exact missing source, a named owning lane and a handoff scope, and the participant journey correctly says these forms are obtained by the participant and not drafted by LegalEase — but a composed route with a blocked primary filing is not terminal, and the shard rule is that one nonterminal unit bars approval. Held rather than correction_required because the blocker is genuine external source acquisition, not a lane error.
